chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Visit those who do not visit you, and give gifts to those who do not give gifts to you.
ai.seo_question: How does Imam عليه السلام teach believers to treat people who do not reciprocate visits or gifts?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches noble character by urging a believer to maintain ties and show generosity even when others do not reciprocate. Its significance lies in promoting sincere virtue, social harmony, and acting for Allah’s sake rather than on the basis of equal return.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Visit those who do not visit you, and give gifts to those who do not give gifts to you."
